test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The thieves had no alternative/ but to acquiesce with/ the orders of/ the police.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence lies in the incorrect use of the preposition "**with**" after the verb "**acquiesce**."
 
• The correct preposition that follows "**acquiesce**" is "**to**," not "with."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**acquiesce to** the orders of," which means to agree or comply passively.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

**Correct Sentence:** *The thieves had no alternative but to **acquiesce to** the orders of the police.*
